title: PBit1: One Programmable P-Bit per Parameter - A Finite-Control Representation of Pretrained Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.19588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce PBit1, a finite-control representation of pretrained neural networks that assigns one programmable p-bit to each learned parameter. A 12-bit command sets its probability, a shared affine range maps that probability to the weight domain, and temporal observations reconstruct the weight for inference. Operator-aware range grouping and sensitivity-based sampling allocation adapt the representation to the network. Across five independent weight draws at 32,768 observations per scalar, selected configurations preserve task quality in GPT-2, DistilBERT, and LFM3-1.7B with every learned scalar converted and no fine-tuning. GPT-2 and LFM3 perplexity increase by approximately 0.66% and 0.26%, respectively, while DistilBERT accuracy changes from 87.51% to 87.49%. A sensitivity-based policy reduces GPT-2 reconstruction observations by 41.7% while retaining the quality criterion. Complete-model evaluations reuse reconstructed weights

translated_title: PBit1：每个参数一个可编程P比特——预训练网络的有限控制表示
translated_abstract: 我们提出了PBit1，这是一种预训练神经网络的有限控制表示方法，它为每个已学习参数分配一个可编程的p比特。一个12比特的命令用于设置其概率，一个共享的仿射范围将该概率映射到权重域，并通过时间上的多次观测来重建权重以进行推理。算子感知的范围分组和基于敏感度的采样分配使该表示能够自适应于网络结构。在五次独立权重抽取、每个标量32,768次观测的条件下，所选配置在GPT-2、DistilBERT和LFM3-1.7B上保持了任务质量，所有已学习标量均被转换且无需任何微调。GPT-2和LFM3的困惑度分别增加约0.66%和0.26%，DistilBERT的准确率从87.51%变为87.49%。基于敏感度的策略在保持质量标准的同时，将GPT-2的重建观测次数减少了41.7%。完整模型评估会复用重建的权重
tldr: PBit1为预训练网络的每个学习参数分配一个可编程p比特，通过12比特命令设置概率、共享仿射范围映射和时序观测重建权重，在无需微调的情况下以极小的质量损失（如GPT-2困惑度仅增加0.66%）实现了整模型的有限控制表示，并通过敏感度策略将重建观测次数减少41.7%。
